category_title: Low-achieving students with impulsive behavior and resistance to support (Type 2)
scenario_title: Delayed recall on final written assignment
minimal_context: The student is completing an individual final written assignment involving verbal subtraction problems a week after the last lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your final written assignment. Please solve this verbal subtraction problem: 100 minus 63.50.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the task) I don't remember how to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to figure it out.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you write down your calculation strategy on the worksheet?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. (Pushes the paper away, leaving no evidence of any calculation strategy on her worksheet and reverting to resistance)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is your final written assignment. Please solve this verbal subtraction problem: 100 minus 63.50.

STUDENT: (Looks at the task) I don't remember how to do this.

TUTOR: Just try your best to figure it out.

STUDENT: (Impulsively) It's 40.

TUTOR: Can you write down your calculation strategy on the worksheet?

STUDENT: No. (Pushes the paper away, leaving no evidence of any calculation strategy on her worksheet and reverting to resistance)

task.content: Completing the final written assignment involving verbal subtraction problems (e.g., 100 - 63.50)

context.time_context: Conducted a week after the last lesson

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When attempting to solve similar tasks in the final assignment a week after the program ended
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Failed to solve similar tasks, left no evidence of any calculation strategy in her worksheet, exhibited an inability to perform several of the relevant procedures successfully, and reverted sometimes to impulsive behavior or resistance
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Unable to remember or apply past knowledge to the situation at hand

behavior_patterns.condition: During the subsequent computer session in Lesson 5
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Managed to solve a succession of tasks at the same level of difficulty using the same strategy, as demonstrated in her explanation to her peer
related_quotes: Twenty minus 10 equals 10… [minus two equals] eight. Look, seven [NIS] and 20 agorot. Right?

behavior_patterns.condition: When completing written individual tasks (exercises J-N) in Lesson 5
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Could even apply her strategy to written individual tasks
